question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Entered".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence '*Appu broke his crate and (5) ______ the flight cabin. The pilot made an emergency landing in Kenya*.' conveys that Appu broke his crate and went into the flight cabin.
 
• So, we need to fill the **blank number 5 **with the most appropriate word which will convey the same sense as mentioned above.
 
• Marked option** 'entered'** means to come or go in or into a place.
 
 
• ***Example: **She climbed the stairs and **entered** their room.*
 
 
 
• From the **given meaning** and the example given above, we are sure that the most appropriate word is marked option** 'entered'** which conveys the same sense as Appu went into the flight cabin.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 1.**

**Complete Sentence** *:Appu broke his crate and **entered **the flight cabin. *
